title: Choose the visual world — Canada Visa Tracker
question: The roll assigned The Day Leaf (wall calendar). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Sketches show the India country page on a phone.

options.label: The Day Leaf
options.lineage: tear-off shop wall calendars (India, Nigeria, Philippines households)
options.thesis: The wait is a number of days, so the page is a calendar leaf.
options.viewport: Country + type tabs, then a leaf: the day count huge, 'apply today → decision around 19 Nov', the sponsor strip at the leaf's foot; below, history as a month grid with each day's published wait.
options.risk: Calendar red reads as alarm unless red stays on Sundays only.

raised.raise: Every number is stated once on the page; nothing labelled twice.
One reserved ink (green) marks only the visitor's own date and country.
Layout snaps to the month grid's 7-column cell module.
All figures in tabular numerals on one aligned column system.

options.label: The Forecast
options.thesis: A processing time is a forecast: an estimate, a range, an outlook.
options.viewport: The day count as today's 'high', a 'steady / rising' outlook line, and a 26-week trend drawn like a temperature graph.
options.risk: Familiar: where most runs in this category land; the weather costume can trivialise a visa.

options.label: The Route Map
options.lineage: metro line diagrams on midnight enamel
options.thesis: Your application is a journey; the four visa types are four lines.
options.viewport: A line from Applied to Decision with day ticks as stations; the visitor line brightest, the others dimmed.
options.case: Wins audience identification (migration as a journey); loses on clarity, since IRCC publishes one total, not stages.
options.risk: Implies stages we don't have data for; dark-first fights the daylight scene.

options.label: The Dense Board
options.thesis: All four visa types, peers and trend tiled in one packed screen.
options.viewport: Ruled modules: visitor figure, three other types, trend, peers, sponsor module, all above the fold.
options.case: Wins clarity for the 212-country hub and ad modules; loses identification. Utility red translated to blue (no-alarm commitment).
options.risk: Tiny type hurts second-language readers on phones.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.viewport: A pulse plot of history on black.
options.case: Fuses poorly: decoding is the opposite of a plain answer.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Terrain fixed, your course in purple.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no geography in the job.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Numbers built on a visible grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly for a lookup task.
options.kept: A single cell module governs layout.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean data-tracker site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Search, big number card, type cards, line chart, table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
